ApplyPreset.Description: Apply a preset (replaces the scene unless Merge = true).

Overrides.Description: configuration merged on top of the preset

Batch.Description: Run several commands in order. Atomic (default true) reverts everything if any command fails.

CreateParticleSystem.Description: Create or replace a named particle system.

CreateScene.Description: Create a complete scene from a configuration or a description { Mood, Time, Weather, Environment, Fog, LightingStyle, WaterStyle }.

CreateWeather.Description: Set the weather. Type is a weather type; Configuration holds Intensity, Wind, Fog, Lightning, RainIntensity, ...

CreateZone.Description: Create or replace a spatial effect zone (Environment.Zones).

DeletePreset.Description: Delete a user preset (built-in presets are protected).

DetectConflicts.Description: Detect conflicts in the live scene (duplicates, stacked effects, ignored fog, ...).

DiffScene.Description: Compare a configuration with the live scene without changing anything.

Merge.Description: diff the result of merging instead of replacing

ExportConfiguration.Description: Export the current configuration. Format: table | json | document.

GenerateCode.Description: Generate readable Luau for a configuration (default: current).

Options.Description: { Template = Script | LocalScript | Module | Transition, RequirePath, Comments }

GetDocumentation.Description: Structured agent guide (workflow, rules, actions, examples).

GetPerformanceStats.Description: Workload estimates (particle systems, particle rate, managed instances, update frequency).

GetPreset.Description: Return a preset's resolved configuration (inheritance expanded).

GetSchema.Description: Machine-readable schema of sections, fields, weather types, templates, presets and commands.

ImportConfiguration.Description: Validate and apply a configuration (table, VisualFXConfig document or JSON text).

InspectScene.Description: Structured description of the current visual state, managed effects and conflicts.

ListActions.Description: List every action with its fields.

ListPresets.Description: List presets. Filter: { Category, Source, Search }.

PreviewScene.Description: Apply a configuration as a revertible preview (merge unless Replace).

RemoveWeather.Description: Remove the weather and everything it created.

ResetManagedEffects.Description: Remove all VisualFX-managed effects and restore original values. Developer content is untouched.

RevertPreview.Description: Undo the current preview exactly (developer edits made meanwhile are kept).

SavePreset.Description: Save a configuration (default: the current one) as a user preset.

SetAtmosphere.Description: Set Atmosphere properties (merge; Replace = true to replace).

Replace.Description: replace the section instead of merging

SetLighting.Description: Set Lighting service properties (merge; Replace = true to replace).

SetPostProcessing.Description: Set post-processing effects { Bloom, ColorCorrection, DepthOfField, SunRays, Blur }.

SetQuality.Description: Set the quality level (Low | Medium | High | Ultra | Custom) with optional overrides.

SetWater.Description: Set terrain water properties (merge; Replace = true to replace).

TransitionScene.Description: Smoothly transition to a configuration (merged) or preset over Duration seconds.

Easing.Description: Linear | Smooth | Sine | Quad | Cubic | Quart | Quint | Expo | Circular | Back

Replace.Description: treat Configuration as a complete scene

UpdateParticleSystem.Description: Merge changes into an existing particle system.

UpdateScene.Description: Merge changes into the current scene. Use "$remove" to delete keys.

UpdateWeather.Description: Merge changes into the current weather (e.g. Intensity).

ValidateConfiguration.Description: Validate a configuration (default: current) without applying it.

Notes: Values are case/format-insensitive: "light_rain", "Light Rain" and "LightRain" are equivalent.
Time also accepts a number (ClockTime 0-24). Fog also accepts a number 0-1.
Intensity (0-1) scales weather; any configuration section (Lighting, Atmosphere, ...) may be included to override the result.

MergeRules: Scalars and Roblox values in an overlay replace the base value.
Dictionaries merge recursively, key by key.
Arrays are replaced as a whole.
Keys are processed in sorted order.

MetaKeys.Inherits: list of preset names merged left to right before this configuration

Custom.Description: Plain emitter; configure every property yourself.

Dust.Description: Floating dust motes around the camera.

Fireflies.Description: Slow glowing points that fade in and out.

Fog.Description: Large, soft, slow smoke sprites that read as low-lying volumetric fog.

Leaves.Description: Tumbling falling leaves (use a leaf texture for best results).

Mist.Description: Thin, low mist; subtler than Fog.

Rain.Description: Falling rain streaks (stretched with Squash, aligned to velocity).

Snow.Description: Slowly drifting snowflakes that respond to wind.

Sections.Name: Effects
Sections.Description: Instances of custom effect types registered with VisualFX:RegisterEffect.

Autumn.Description: Warm autumn light with falling leaves.

Custom.Description: No built-in influence; compose it with Weather.Particles and the other Weather fields.

MagicalStorm.Description: Otherworldly storm with glowing particles and violet lightning.

Thunderstorm.Description: Dark storm with heavy rain, wind and lightning.
